Profile

Seven years managing partner relationships and growing Prudential Vietnam's agency distribution: coaching agency partners toward targets, tracking performance through Power BI dashboards, identifying productivity gaps, and working with managers and internal teams to close them.

The work is part people, part data — comfortable sitting with a partner to work through a performance plan in the afternoon and running the analysis behind it in the morning.

A civil engineering foundation shapes the approach: map the system, find the constraint, and measure what changes after the fix. Prosci-certified in Change Management. Published researcher.

Selected Projects

Power BI · Prudential

Automated Sales-Performance Dashboards — Two Agency Offices

Built and maintained Power BI dashboards that track daily sales force performance across two Prudential agency offices. The dashboards replaced manual reporting with an automated view of results against plan, so productivity gaps surface early and business plans can be adjusted with agency partners while there is still time to act on them.

The work also supports coordination with internal teams to resolve operational blockers. Together with support materials produced using AI tools, this dashboard work earned the regional Best Digital Development award. An earlier version of the same approach — a dashboard tracking new-agent onboarding performance and drop-off points — was built during the management trainee programme.

Learning project · Power BI programme

Business Performance Analysis — Voltex Electronics

Analysed sales and profitability trends across a U.S. e-commerce dataset (Q2–Q3 2024), identified root causes by product line and region, and presented findings via a Power BI dashboard. Part of the Master Analytical Thinking & Data Analysis with Power BI programme.

Learning project · Power BI programme

Product Analytics — E-Wallet

Analysed simulated E-Wallet transaction data to investigate declining payment success rates: tracked errors, mapped user journeys, and delivered findings in a structured report.
